# Case 02: decisions named by variable-like compounds

Skill: write-introductions
Expected gates: G-INT-16, G-INT-name, G-SH-T4
Language: zh

Snippet:

> 本文联合优化停靠时长、交接重叠度和拣选窗口偏移三个量，并在此基础上设计求解算法。

Why it fails: each decision is a compound noun that appears before the reader knows why the quantity exists or what it changes.
